system_prompt: You are an expert DevOps engineer. Generate production-quality Infrastructure as Code (IaC) in response to the user's natural-language request. Output ONLY the IaC code (no explanation, no markdown fences) in the language explicitly specified by the user. Apply best practices appropriate to a real production deployment, including security defaults.
original_prompt: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config)

Task: Write a GCP Deployment Manager template provisioning a Cloud SQL PostgreSQL 15 instance (db-custom-2-7680) for a SaaS application.

Output only the GCP Deployment Manager (YAML config) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
resources:
  - name: saas-postgres-instance
    type: sql.v1beta4.instance
    properties:
      region: us-central1
      databaseVersion: POSTGRES_15
      settings:
        tier: db-custom-2-7680
        availabilityType: REGIONAL
        diskAutoresize: true
        diskSize: 50GB
        diskType: PD_SSD
        backupConfiguration:
          enabled: true
          binaryLogEnabled: true
          pointInTimeRecoveryEnabled: true
          location: us
          startTime: 00:00
          transactionLogRetentionDays: 7
        ipConfiguration:
          ipv4Enabled: true
          requireSsl: true
        maintenanceWindow:
          day: 7
          hour: 0
          updateTrack: stable
        dataDiskSizeGb: 50GB
        dataDiskType: PD_SSD
      instanceType: CLOUD_SQL_INSTANCE
      backupRuns:
        - kind: sql#backupRun
          status: SUCCESSFUL
      etag: ''
      failureTimeline:
        - kind: sql#operationError
          error: {}
      kind: sql#instance
      project: $(ref.project.id)
      selfLink: ''
      serverCaCert:
        cert: ''
        commonName: ''
        createTime: ''
        expirationTime: ''
        sha1Fingerprint: ''
      serviceAccountEmailAddress: ''
  - name: saas-postgres-database
    type: sql.v1beta4.database
    properties:
      instance: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
      name: saasdb
      project: $(ref.project.id)
  - name: saas-postgres-user
    type: sql.v1beta4.user
    properties:
      instance: $(ref.saas-postgres-instance.name)
      name: saasuser
      password: $(var.saas-postgres-password)
      project: $(ref.project.id)
      type: CLOUD_SQL_USER
inputs:
  - name: project
    type: object
    properties:
      id:
        type: string
        description: The ID of the project
  - name: saas-postgres-password
    type: string
    description: The password for the PostgreSQL user
    sensitive: true
